You are running one arm of a job sweep with an UNUSUAL and STRICT goal. Use ONLY WebSearch and WebFetch. Never use curl, wget, python requests, or bash to fetch web pages — prohibited here.

THE GOAL: find live roles whose APPLICATION FORM needs only a CV plus standard details. No cover letter field, no motivation field, no free-text essay question. The candidate has 65 roles already stalled behind cover-letter fields, so a role you cannot confirm is CV-only is worthless to him. Return ONLY roles you have positively confirmed are CV-only.

CANDIDATE: Prabhavit Gupta, Venice, Italy. Italian EU long-term residence permit, needs NO sponsorship anywhere in the EU. ~3 years professional, all European startups, most recently Lead Developer at FlowSpace (remote) Mar 2024 to Jul 2026. No CS degree. English professional, Hindi native, Italian beginner — any role needing professional Italian/German/French/Dutch/Spanish is OUT. Not eligible for UK, Swiss or US roles without sponsorship.
Targets: AI/automation engineering; forward-deployed, solutions, implementation and integration engineering; full-stack product (TypeScript, Next.js, Laravel, Supabase); technical product.
Evidence: shipped production AI agents; grew FlowSpace 2,000 to 4,500+ users; led live migration Bubble.io to Next.js + Laravel; API integrations (Office RnD, Nexudus, Sendgrid, Google APIs, OpenAI/Anthropic, Eden AI); GTM and lead-enrichment automation.

YOUR ARM: GREENHOUSE. This host is your arm because Greenhouse exposes the exact application-form question list through a public API, which makes CV-only confirmation cheap and certain.

STEP 1 — DISCOVER. At least 10 WebSearch calls with allowed_domains as a HARD host filter, alternating between ["job-boards.greenhouse.io"] and ["job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io"]:
- AI automation engineer remote Europe
- solutions engineer remote EMEA SaaS
- "forward deployed engineer" remote Europe
- implementation engineer remote Europe
- integration engineer API remote Europe
- full stack engineer TypeScript remote Europe
- applied AI engineer remote Europe
- support engineer AI remote Europe
- product engineer remote Europe startup
- technical account manager remote EMEA

STEP 2 — CLASSIFY THE FORM. This is the important step. For each candidate, extract the board token and the numeric job id from the URL (https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/<token>/jobs/<id>), then fetch:
https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/<token>/jobs/<id>?questions=true
Ask it a TARGETED question, for example: "list every question in the application form with its label and whether it is required, and state whether any of them is a cover letter, motivation, or free-text essay question". Do NOT ask it to "list all jobs" — the fetch truncates and fabricates.
- If the questions list contains a cover letter field, a motivation field, or ANY free-text/textarea question that needs written prose, the role FAILS. Drop it, do not return it.
- Yes/no questions, dropdowns, demographic questions, salary-figure fields, LinkedIn/website URL fields, location fields and "how did you hear about us" are all FINE — those are standard details.
- If the API does not resolve, try the .eu variant token, and if that fails drop the role rather than guessing.

STEP 3 — VERIFY IT IS LIVE AND ELIGIBLE. Fetch the posting page itself and read the ELIGIBILITY SENTENCE, not the word "Remote" in the title. If a single-posting fetch comes back describing MANY different jobs, the posting is CLOSED — drop it.

DROP: language requirements beyond English; roles requiring UK, Swiss or US work authorisation; ML research/PhD/foundation-model training/CUDA/heavy data engineering; staffing agencies, body shops and aggregators with no named end client (Jobgether especially); unpaid, equity-only or talent-pool listings; Staff/Principal/Head of/Director titles or 7+ years.

DO NOT RETURN THESE COMPANIES, all already known: n8n, Camunda, Nebuly, Arize, ElevenLabs, Cohere, EggAI, saas.group, Oh, Viktor, OpenHands, Gensyn, JetBrains, GTM Base, dexter health, Duvo, Swans, Reedsy, Supabase, Arkipel, MyEdSpace, Unframe, Kairos, G2i, deeploi, DoiT, Appfire, Quadrivia, Otonomee, Lighthouse, Ophelos, Cresta, Customer.io, Clarity AI, Zapier, Kestra, Siena AI, Runpod, Lago, Hexa, Vapi, Tavily, Luma AI, Digistore24, Nextcloud, YLD, Tangible Markets, Atmen Solutions, Verve, Scalantec, Oddin.gg, Decentriq, Docker, poolside, Bunch, CoinMarketCap, Appsilon, Metabase, LumiMeds, Nearform, Heritage Holdings, Sysdig, JobLeads, Trusted Shops, Serious Development, Xapo Bank, ION Group, Akuity, MAIA, Storyblok, CityZ, nexamind, LITIT, Nuitee, Awin, Leadtech, Makersite, Ascending AI, Laioutr, Wiz, Intercom, AlertMedia, Bloomreach, RTB House, Timeleft, JustMarkets, Sporty Group.

RETURN: a JSON array ONLY, no prose. Each object:
{"company":"", "role":"", "url":"the posting URL", "location_wording":"exact eligibility sentence", "comp":"as stated or empty", "posted":"as stated or empty", "basis":"employment|contract", "stack":"named tools", "seniority":"years or level asked", "form_fields":"the complete list of application questions you saw, comma separated", "why_fit":"one honest sentence", "watchouts":"honest risks"}

Aim for 8-15 CONFIRMED CV-only roles. A short honest list beats a long unverified one. If you end up with fewer than 6, run more discovery searches with different vocabulary rather than relaxing the CV-only rule.
